zh.title: 加拿大航空兩月內啟動A321XLR希斯洛八小時直飛
zh.summary: 加拿大航空兩月內以A321XLR飛希思羅；未來將由三座加拿大城市飛倫敦
body: 加拿大航空（Air Canada）預計在兩個月內以A321XLR開通飛往倫敦希思羅（Heathrow）的八小時直飛航班。此消息依據Simple Flying的報導，該報導的標題即指出「Air Canada Begins 8-Hour Nonstop A321XLR Heathrow Flights In 2 Months」。
報導中並提到，這家加拿大航空公司未來將以A321XLR自加拿大三座城市飛往倫敦。報導摘要寫道：「The carrier will eventually fly its A321XLRs to London from three Canadian cities.」，顯示此為該公司規劃中的航線擴展方向。
目前報導僅列出上述時程與城市數量，並未提供具體啟航日期、票價或三座城市的確切名稱，實際航班安排仍待航空公司正式公佈。

en.title: Air Canada to Start 8-Hour Nonstop A321XLR Heathrow Flights in 2 Months; Routes Revealed
en.summary: Air Canada to begin 8-hour A321XLR Heathrow nonstops in 2 months; to serve London from three Canadian cities
body: Air Canada is set to begin eight-hour nonstop flights to London Heathrow using the A321XLR within two months, according to Simple Flying. The report's headline states "Air Canada Begins 8-Hour Nonstop A321XLR Heathrow Flights In 2 Months."
The same report notes that the carrier will eventually operate its A321XLRs to London from three Canadian cities, as stated in the summary.
The report provides only this timeline and route structure; specifics on exact start dates, the three cities, or flight schedules are not included.
